steps: Share your unique CPB referral link with a friend.
Friend opens a new CPB checking account using the link.
You and the friend each receive the bonus within 60 days: $20 for Shaka/Value Checking, $50 for Exceptional Checking.
timing: The bonus is credited to the referrer's existing checking account within 60 days.
when_cash_arrives: The bonus is credited to the referrer's existing checking account within 60 days. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
